telebirr.instructions: Transfer the exact order total to our Telebirr merchant/phone number. After completing the transfer, take a screenshot of the confirmation SMS or transaction screen and upload it on your order confirmation page.

cbe_birr.instructions: Send the total order amount via CBE Birr to the account number above. Keep the transaction reference number and upload the receipt image.

bank_transfer.instructions: Deposit or transfer the exact order amount to our bank account. Ensure your Order Number is included in the transfer remark/reference, and upload a clear picture of the deposit slip or mobile banking transfer confirmation.

cash_on_delivery.instructions: Pay in cash or local mobile transfer to the delivery agent upon receiving and inspecting your items at your delivery address. No receipt upload required.
